answer: Make trust grow like a meadow, not a monoculture: reputation must spread slowly from many attested jobs, so a new identity starts bare and earns credit one verified task at a time. A comet-fast signup that asks nothing lets fakes streak in by the thousand, while a crystal-clear record — layered, public, hard to fake — exposes clusters of fresh accounts moving in lockstep. Charge a small locked stake per identity, and cheap copies stay worthless.
